text:
maya: Heads-up design review for routing editor — found a few small but important UX + a11y tweaks for the priority list. Sharing quick thoughts.

jordan: Thanks. Main pain: long lists are hard to scan, equal-priority rules feel non-deterministic, and the simulator control is buried.

sam: Agree. Copy changes: avoid alarmist language. Replace 'Invalid rule' with 'Conflicting rule' and offer a subtle 'View conflict' action that focuses the other rule.

taylor: Simulator placement suggestion: move 'Run simulation' to the preview header (left of title) and add a compact live vs one-off toggle. Users expect local controls.

lee: Accessibility notes: drag handle contrast ~2.2:1 — bump to #595f63 or add a 2px focus ring. Keyboard reorder pattern needed: Space to pick up, arrows to move, Space to drop; expose `aria-describedby` when reorder mode active.

maya: tiny CSS example from Lee would be helpful for the PR.

lee: Quick snippet: `.drag-handle{ color:#595f63 } .drag-handle:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid #0A7BFF; outline-offset:2px }`

jordan: Tie-breaker idea: when priorities tie, show a subtle dotted icon that reveals creation time / rule-id on hover — helps power users debug ordering without cluttering UI.

sam: Also the preview list updates aren't announced — add `aria-live="polite"` to the preview container so screen readers catch simulation results.

taylor: For density tradeoffs, can we offer a compact row and a comfy row toggle in the toolbar (defaults to compact for >8 rules)? That reduces visual heft.

maya: I'll prototype: (1) compact vs comfy rows, (2) sticky priority column with tie-breaker tooltip, (3) relocated preview control, (4) keyboard reordering demo. ETA: Thursday EOD.

jordan: Action items: Maya — mocks + HTML demo; Lee — file a11y ticket with contrast numbers + keyboard acceptance tests; Sam — update validation copy doc and wire 'View conflict' focus action; Taylor — relocate simulator and add live/one-off; I'll schedule a 20-min sync Friday to review.

designbot: Checklist added to design PR: compact/comfy mocks, sticky priority col, drag contrast + focus, keyboard reorder, preview toggle relocation, softened validation copy.

maya: Great, will drop mocks in this thread when ready. Please flag anything blocking signoff.
